written: 2026-11-18 14:36, before any sub-band was compared with a diagnosis
status: private; not for the README, the deck or the report; reported whatever it shows
question: Do finer frequency bands, with far fewer features, separate AD (36) from FTD (23)?
data: ds004504 eyes closed, derivatives; every patient's first 75 clean 4 s epochs (300 s, no ASR join)
features: Hann-windowed spectrum per 4 s epoch (0.25 Hz bins, 0.5-45 Hz), divided by that epoch's total power, averaged over epochs and over the channels of each region (frontal Fp1 Fp2 F3 F4 F7 F8 Fz; posterior P3 P4 Pz O1 O2); a band's feature is log10 of its summed relative power

division_of_frequencies.rival_alpha_anchored: edges 1, I-6, I-4, I-2, I, I+2, I+4, 20, 30 Hz, I = the patient's alpha centre of gravity (spec_iaf_cog, 6-13 Hz, rounded to 0.25 Hz); I is also a feature (17)
division_of_frequencies.rival_learned: 8 contiguous bands per region with edges on the grid 1, 2, ..., 13, 15, 17, 20, 25, 30 Hz, maximising the sum of squared two-sample t statistics between the training classes (dynamic programming); learned inside every training set, including the inner folds (16). The grid widens above 13 Hz because a 1 Hz grid piled edges into 22-29 Hz on shuffled diagnoses; this was fixed before any real diagnosis was used
division_of_frequencies.baseline: the 5 classic bands 0.5-4, 4-8, 8-13, 13-30, 30-45 Hz x 2 regions = 10 features
division_of_frequencies.reference: the 95 existing bp_ band powers on the same 300 s

division_of_patients.primary: nested leave-one-subject-out: each patient is scored by a model fitted on the task's other patients; C from [0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1] by 5-fold inner stratified CV AUC, inner seed 42 + fold number
division_of_patients.stability: 5 x 5-fold on the saved folds of Experiments 9 and 10, inner seed 42 + 100 x repeat + fold

model: StandardScaler, then L2 logistic regression with balanced class weights (Experiment 10's pipeline)

tasks.controls: AD vs HC and dementia vs HC, LOSO only, to see what fewer features cost

statistics: patient AUC; accuracy at 0.5; 95 % CI from 2000 bootstrap resamples per class, seed 42; one-sided permutation p from 1000 shuffles of the 59 diagnoses through the whole LOSO pipeline; Holm over the primary and its two rivals

claims.A_separates_AD_from_FTD: Holm p < 0.05 under LOSO, and the lower 95 % bound of the same model's 5 x 5 AUC is above 0.5
claims.B_better_than_5_bands: the 95 % CI of the LOSO AUC gain over the 5-band baseline is above 0
claims.C_fewer_features_cost_nothing: AD vs HC and dementia vs HC: the lower 95 % bound of the LOSO AUC difference (16 features minus 95) is above -0.05

already_seen: results for the 5 classic bands, the alpha centre of gravity and lagged cross-correlation (C3). No sub-band has been compared with a diagnosis
limits: same patients as every earlier AD-vs-FTD experiment; 23 FTD patients give about 49 % power at AUC 0.65, so a null result cannot exclude a small effect; a positive result needs an independent cohort
